title: task→transcript: ~40% of assignee records carry no session; exact-match silently misses them — use time-window overlap correlation
summary: When resolving a task to its transcript path (resolveOwner / task→transcript join), a direct/exact-session-only resolver is WRONG: on real data ~40% of assignee agent records carry no session and no transcript_path, so exact-session resolution recovered only ~60% of tasks. Those rows are recoverable ONLY by correlating the task's claim window against harness run windows (byWindow): pick the run whose [start,end] interval overlaps the task window with the largest overlap (overlap = min(ends)-max(starts), >=0 counts as touching; missing end widens to now). Discovered empirically when exact-session resolution silently dropped ~40% of tasks on real data. Always include the time-window correlation fallback after direct and session-of-assignee lookups.
